decisions.summary: split the extra volume of Nylon fabric type 22 with a second supplier

messages.author: EMP-007
messages.text: Can Suarez LLC [SYNTH] cover a 20% forecast increase on Nylon fabric type 22 in Q3?

messages.author: EMP-033
messages.text: They can do 10% from the current plant, the rest needs overtime.

messages.author: EMP-007
messages.text: Decision: split the extra volume of Nylon fabric type 22 with a second supplier.
